title: A value key with an honest equality contract
instructions: Implement immutable GridKey(row, column), with integer coordinates and accessors. Two keys are equal exactly when both coordinates are equal.
Use a final class and implement equals(Object) and hashCode(). Explain why different keys may share a hash code without being equal.
DelftStudy authored practice. The time class is a suggested practice budget, not an official assessment duration.
Write and review your own attempt before revealing the reference. Code on this page is ephemeral and is not compiled, run or automatically graded. Multiple correct implementations are valid.

starterFiles.name: GridKey.java

requirements.text: Store both coordinates privately and immutably; expose their values without setters.
Implement reflexive, symmetric, transitive and consistent value equality; reject null and unrelated types.
Equal keys must have equal hash codes and behave as one logical key in a HashSet; hash collisions must not imply equality.
